question: The marked price of a smartwatch set is ₹640. It sells with two successive discounts of 30% and 25%. An additional 25% discount is given on cash payment. What is the selling price (in ₹) of the smartwatch set on cash payment?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **Marked Price (MP)** is ₹640.

Successive discounts are 30%, 25%, and an additional 25% for cash.

**Selling Price (SP)** = 640 × (70 ÷ 100) × (75 ÷ 100) × (75 ÷ 100).

SP = 640 × (7 ÷ 10) × (3 ÷ 4) × (3 ÷ 4).

SP = 640 × (63 ÷ 160) = 4 × 63 = 252.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹252.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** MP = ₹640, D₁ = 30%, D₂ = 25%, D₃ (cash) = 25%.

**Formula:** SP = MP × (100 − D₁)% × (100 − D₂)% × (100 − D₃)%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0361c32be892b5251638ec870f775a3995dd5df1bce967e909cb99d4fef9c8ef.png] 

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 640 − (30% of 640) = 640 − 192 = 448.

⇒ Price after 2nd discount = 448 − (25% of 448) = 448 − 112 = 336.

⇒ Price after 3rd (cash) discount = 336 − (25% of 336) = 336 − 84 = 252.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹252.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When multiple discounts are applied one after another, the single equivalent discount for two discounts a% and b% is given by (a + b − ab ÷ 100)%.

Marked Price & Selling Price

Marked Price is the listed price on the tag. Selling Price is the final amount paid after deducting all applicable discounts from the MP.
